**Remove token-derived IDs from APNs logs and keep per-push result logs at debug level.**

These logs still emit a stable device-derived identifier (`token_id`) and promote per-push outcomes to info/warn/error. That breaks the push logging policy and creates correlatable user-level telemetry.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
@@
-fn redacted_device_token_id(device_token: &str) -> String {
-    let digest = Sha256::digest(device_token.as_bytes());
-    format!("sha256:{}", hex::encode(&digest[..6]))
-}
@@
-    async fn handle_response(
-        &self,
-        start: Instant,
-        response: reqwest::Response,
-        device_token_id: &str,
-    ) -> SendAttemptResult {
+    async fn handle_response(&self, start: Instant, response: reqwest::Response) -> SendAttemptResult {
@@
-                info!(
-                    token_id = %device_token_id,
+                debug!(
                     payload_mode = %self.config.payload_mode,
                     status = status.as_u16(),
                     "APNs notification accepted"
                 );
@@
-                warn!(
-                    token_id = %device_token_id,
+                debug!(
                     payload_mode = %self.config.payload_mode,
                     reason = %error.reason,
                     "APNs bad request"
                 );
@@
-                error!(
-                    token_id = %device_token_id,
+                debug!(
                     payload_mode = %self.config.payload_mode,
                     reason = %error.reason,
                     "APNs authentication error"
                 );
@@
-        let device_token_id = redacted_device_token_id(device_token);
@@

-            token_id = %device_token_id,
```
